svg.title: Three Rivers: a three-way king of the hill map
svg.desc: The hill is an island in a lake, reached by one causeway bridge facing each base. Three rivers run out from the lake between the teams, so every neighbour is across water: an inner and an outer bridge and a metal-rich ford in the middle of each river. Hills by the banks make clefts on the way down to them.
svg.text: Three-way king of the hill · 18 × 18 map (9216 game units square) · 1v1v1 to 3v3v3
The hill is an island in a lake, reached by one causeway bridge facing each base. Three rivers run out
from the lake between the teams, so every neighbour is across water: an inner and an outer bridge and a
metal-rich ford in the middle of each river. Hills by the banks make clefts on the way down to them.
Heights: plateau 240 · banks 120 · island 260 to 300 · lake and rivers 60 deep, fords 10 deep
Planet Kapok · a steaming jungle river world
Ground: dense green jungle floor, red-brown mud banks along the rivers, moss-green rock in the
Plants: kapoktree canopy on the plateau, ad0_senegal palms along the banks and on the island, ferns
Features: rocks30_moss on the river hills and through the fords, a sunken corpship_dead and
Sky and weather: humid white-green haze, fog low over the water; wind 2 to 10; tidal 22.
Each third is the same, turned 120° about the hill. Heights in game units; lighter ground stands higher.
